annotations.title: Uniswap pool, V3 pool: state and price

description: Uniswap v3 pools for a token pair on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon, read live from the factory and each pool: pool address per fee tier (0.01%, 0.05%, 0.3%, 1%), price of each token in the other, current tick, in-range liquidity and both token balances held, deepest pool first. Tokens by 0x address or ticker. Use to find the right pool, check depth before a swap or read a spot price. Example: tokenA=WETH, tokenB=USDC. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
